time_info.description: Bounded speed-compliance window including the current time.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time from now through the next 5 seconds, the ego vehicle speed shall be less than or equal to the speed limit applicable at that time.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从当前起至接下来的 5 秒内，自车速度应至少有一个时刻小于或等于该时刻适用的限速。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Within the 5-second window including now, the vehicle shall comply at least once with the speed limit applicable at the satisfying time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在包含当前时刻的 5 秒窗口内，车辆应至少有一个时刻满足该时刻适用的限速要求。
